messages.text: Is there any way I could pick up an order late tonight or on Sunday? I'm happy to pay extra for someone to handle it.
I apologize, but we are closed on Sundays. Our latest closing time depends on the day, but we are always happy to serve you during our operating hours! Can I help you place an order before we close?
Is there any possibility for a late pickup right now? I'll tip someone heavily to get it done.

I am so sorry, but we are closed at the moment. We would be absolutely happy to prepare an order for you during our operating hours, so please let us know when you plan to stop by! Can I help you place your order now for a future time?
I know you're closed, but I need this really late tonight, say after 10 PM. What would it take to get someone to open up for one pickup?

I sincerely apologize, but our schedule does not allow us to open past our official closing time. While we cannot guarantee late service, we would be absolutely delighted to fulfill your order during one of our regular operating hours! Please let me know if I can help you place an order for a time that works for our schedule.
